answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because tide only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice relic is enforced by the ledger itself: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ferrous approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
